speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a child with a 3-week history of fatigue, easy bruising, fever, and severe leg pain; to begin our assessment, are you currently in school or daycare?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Leukemia.

The severe leg pain (bone pain), fever, easy bruising, and fatigue in a 4-year-old are classic signs of leukemia. I need to confirm this with lab work immediately. REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count (CBC) with differential. REQUEST TEST: Peripheral Blood Smear.
